incidents.name: Thoreum V2 transfer business-logic flaw
incidents.notes: Thoreum's transfer() lets a self-transfer or a transfer to the pair inflate the sender's balance through the auto-compounding rebase accounting, so the attacker repeatedly grew a holding and sold it into the WBNB pair.

sources.ref: onchain review: Thoreum 0xce1b3e5087e8215876af976032382dd338cf8401 created 2022-07-15T08:07:01Z by 0x6a963573b9a7aaef9cb9eee747e1b6b2c21b0520, unrelated to attack sender 0x1ae2dc57399b2f4597366c5bf4fe39859c006f99; it is an EIP-1967 proxy with nine Upgraded events, the last at 1674098373 (2023-01-19T05:19:33Z), just over two hours before the incident, which is the basis for the age. lossUsd converts the ~2,000 BNB reported for the incident (this transaction alone moved 6.11 WBNB): 2,000 BNB x $290.78 at incidentTimestamp 1674106022 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $581,560.
